subject.title: fix embedded compaction hook reset API

question: Should `after_compaction` expose a public current-session `resetSession` API, and should the explicit-session-key compatibility overload become part of that permanent plugin contract?
rationale: This adds a compatibility-sensitive plugin capability and preserves an early external calling shape; code review cannot decide whether that overload and lifecycle authority are intended long-term public API.

options.title: Approve reason-only scoped API
options.body: Expose only `resetSession("new" | "reset")`, remove the explicit-key overload, and split unrelated tool-loop policy before merge.

options.title: Approve both call forms
options.body: Keep the explicit-key overload with documented deprecation or permanence, focused compatibility tests, and owner confirmation that deployed consumers justify it.

options.title: Keep reset ownership internal
options.body: Do not expose a plugin API yet; represent post-compaction reset as an owner-controlled compaction outcome until a stable contract is designed.

recommendation.title: Approve reason-only scoped API
recommendation.body: Expose only `resetSession("new" | "reset")`, remove the explicit-key overload, and split unrelated tool-loop policy before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: This choice spans the merged compaction-hook history, public plugin API, and core session-reset ownership boundaries.
